contradictions.what: Rep says customer was building a portal, later says Paul's team builds nothing and the portal is off the shelf with a plugin.
Rep says the deal was dead at 20 percent before the meeting, yet Ines had already stopped Wen with 'go back' and asked to see it with their data.
Rep first says she thought the trigger was the portal, then says the portal was the excuse and the real trigger was the new CFO.
Rep says the reference gap existed and no call happened, but also says she signed anyway, so the gap did not block the deal.
Rep treats Ines as the decider with certainty, yet the first proposal went only to Paul, and she was kept off the first call.
